# Function reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Core Functions

Solve flow and compute transport properties

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [solve_flow](solve_flow.qmd#kabs.solve_flow) | Run a pressure-driven single-phase LBM simulation to steady state. |
| [compute_permeability](compute_permeability.qmd#kabs.compute_permeability) | Compute Darcy permeability from a single-phase LBM simulation. |
| [compute_hydraulic_conductance](compute_hydraulic_conductance.qmd#kabs.compute_hydraulic_conductance) | Compute hydraulic conductance g from a single-phase LBM simulation. |
| [FlowResult](FlowResult.qmd#kabs.FlowResult) | Container for a converged single-phase LBM flow simulation. |

## Utilities

VTR file I/O

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utils.read_flow_vtr](utils.read_flow_vtr.qmd#kabs.utils.read_flow_vtr) | Read a flow .vtr file and return a :class:`~kabs.FlowResult`. |
| [utils.write_flow_vtr](utils.write_flow_vtr.qmd#kabs.utils.write_flow_vtr) | Write a FlowResult to a VTK Rectilinear Grid (.vtr) file. |
